_README: eBay leaf category IDs, keyed by '<gender>:<Shopify productType>'.
eBay requires a LEAF category id on every listing. There is no way to
derive one from a Shopify product type, and a wrong id either rejects the
row or files the garment somewhere no buyer looks. So the ids below are
either verified or null, never guessed, and scripts/ebay-listings.py
refuses to emit any row whose category is still null.
TO FILL A NULL: open eBay Seller Hub -> Listings -> Create listing, type
the garment name into the category search, and take the id from the end of
the resulting browse URL (ebay.com/b/<name>/<ID>/...). Paste it here as a
NOTE 185082 'Active Athletic Apparel for Women' and 185098 'Women's
Activewear' are browse parents, not leaves. Do not list into them.
